content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi recruitment is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi is recruiting for three distinct positions: Principal Project Scientist, Sr. Project Scientist, and Project Scientist. Each post has specific eligibility criteria and salary scales.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Principal Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: For the Principal Project Scientist position, candidates must hold a PhD or a first-class MTech/MSR with 6 years of relevant experience in CS/IT/EE or related fields.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions at IIT Delhi involves an initial shortlisting of eligible candidates, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply for these positions via email. Ensure all necessary documents are attached and the email is sent to the correct address before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position offers a salary in the range of Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 per month, plus an additional HRA of 30%.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Delhi provide age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any specific information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies released by IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Principal Project Scientist, Sr. Project Scientist, and Project Scientist.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the IIT Delhi recruitment can be accessed through the provided link in the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
